Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that validates required structured fields and confidence scores using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import pypdf

from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

# Set up Document AI processor
processor_id = "projects/your-project-id/locations/us-central1/processors/your-processor-id"
client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

def extract_structured_fields(pdf_path):
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        pdf_bytes = f.read()
    pdf_document = pypdf.PdfReader(pdf_bytes)

    # Detect document text
    document = documentai.Document()
    document.text = " ".join(page.extract_text() for page in pdf_document.pages)

    # Process with Document AI
    name = f"projects/{processor_id.split('/')[1]}/locations/us-central1/processors/{processor_id.split('/')[-1]}"
    request = documentai.ProcessDocumentRequest(name=name, document=document)
    response = client.process_document(request=request)

    # Extract structured fields and confidence scores
    extracted_fields = {}
    for entity in response.document.entities:
        if entity.type_ in ["field1", "field2", "field3"]:  # Replace with required field names
            extracted_fields[entity.type_] = {
                "value": entity.mention_text,
                "confidence": entity.confidence
            }

    # Validate required fields and confidence scores
    required_fields = ["field1", "field2", "field3"]  # Replace with required field names
    for required_field in required_fields:
        if required_field not in extracted_fields or extracted_fields[required_field]["confidence"] < 0.8:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing or low confidence for required field: {required_field}")

    return extracted_fields
